name: Securities Option 86
definition: Provides information about the corporate action security option.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the value is a debit or credit.

PostingQuantity.name: Posting Quantity
PostingQuantity.definition: Quantity of securities that have been posted (credit or debit) to the safekeeping account.

PostingDate.name: Posting Date
PostingDate.definition: Date of the posting (credit or debit) to the account.

OriginalPostingDate.name: Original Posting Date
OriginalPostingDate.definition: Date/Time of the posting (credit or debit) to the account that was initially communicated in the confirmation.
